title: docs: add AtlasDocs to the list of tools using Marked
body:
Adds AtlasDocs to the "List of Tools Using Marked" table in `docs/INDEX.md`.

AtlasDocs (https://atlasdocs.io) is a free set of document tools that run entirely in the browser. It uses Marked to convert Markdown to HTML (https://atlasdocs.io/en/markdown-to-html), to PDF (https://atlasdocs.io/en/markdown-to-pdf) and to DOCX, with no file upload. Same spirit as the other entries in the table: a working tool built on Marked, not a plugin.

Documentation only; no code changes.
author: aryribeiro
